scenes.title: Leafen yana buɗe Tailscale
scenes.caption: Leafen yana buɗe shigar da Tailscale a burauzar wannan kwamfutar. Don amfani da wayarku, ku duba lambar QR.

scenes.title: Duba ta da wayarku
scenes.caption: Kyamarar wayarku tana karanta lambar QR, sannan ku danna hanyar haɗin login.tailscale.com da ta nuna.

scenes.title: Shiga Tailscale
scenes.caption: Ku shiga da wani asusu kamar Google, Microsoft, GitHub ko Apple. Idan ba ku da ɗaya, ana ƙirƙira shi a nan.

scenes.title: Ba da izinin adireshin jama'a
scenes.caption: Sannan Leafen yana nuna matakin da ke ba da izinin adireshin jama'a; a cikin burauza, ku danna “Buɗe Tailscale” don buɗe shafinsa. A kan waya, ku duba sabuwar lambar QR.

scenes.title: Kunna HTTPS da Funnel
scenes.caption: Tare da kunna takardun shaida na HTTPS da Funnel, ku danna maɓallin shuɗi. Sunan adireshin yana shiga rikodin takardun shaida na jama'a.

scenes.title: Adireshin ku na jama'a
scenes.caption: Cikin ƴan daƙiƙa Leafen zai nuna adireshin jama'a, inda wayoyi da wakilai a intanet suke shiga.

shows: Abin da ke gaba a wayarku da cikin Tailscale
